transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get ahead of tomorrow's 0900 resupply flight. We've got four cargo lots to place across four positions on the aircraft, and I want to make sure we're tracking all constraints before the 0730 cargo huddle. Let's start working through placement requirements for the battery pallet, refrigerated clinic shipment, generator-filter crate, and communications-cable pallet. What constraints do each of you have that I need to factor into the load plan?

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on the battery pallet. I confirmed this morning that the battery pallet's certified tie-down points are compatible only with the rated fittings at P2. Also, the updated cargo-certification sheet has not yet been attached to the load-plan packet, so we need to make sure that gets included before the XO signs off.
